title: FDA raises bar for foreign site inspections as China trials surge
snippet: Inspection access is not “an administrative footnote,” leaders of key FDA divisions wrote in an editorial on Wednesday vowing to expand oversight of foreign clinical trial sites.

title: Follow the money: How funding announcements can help identify jobs before they’re posted
snippet: Funding announcements can signal future hiring activity, giving biotech professionals a chance to build relationships before positions are posted. Industry experts share how to identify the funding events, milestones and company indicators most likely to lead to new jobs.

title: UniQure files for FDA, UK approval of first gene therapy for Huntington’s disease
snippet: The biologics license application follows months of public speculation—and regulatory reversals—for uniQure’s AMT-130. If accepted by the FDA for priority review, approval could come in the second quarter of 2027.

title: Beyond GLP‑1s: The race for next‑gen obesity drugs starts in the preclinical models
snippet: Efficacy plateaus, muscle loss and weight rebound are testing the limits of GLP-1 success, pushing companies toward new mechanisms and multitarget designs to close the gap. But progress depends on understanding disease biology and selecting the right drug candidates to derisk clinical trials.

title: Tavneos no longer available for new patients in UK as Amgen awaits FDA hearing
snippet: CSL Vifor holds the marketing authorization for Tavneos in the U.K., where the drug is marketed as Avacopan Vifor. It continues to be sold on the U.S. market by Amgen despite concerns raised by the FDA.

title: Novartis’ Rhapsido cuts MS progression in Phase 3 trial, teeing up Roche battle
snippet: Novartis is planning to file for remibrutinib’s expanded approval in relapsing multiple sclerosis by next year, putting it just behind Roche's own BTK inhibitor fenebrutinib.

title: Biopharma reverse mergers rise 1,600% in Q3 to rival IPOs
snippet: Almost as many biotechs have opted for a reverse merger to reach the public markets as those executing more traditional initial public offerings this year.
